summary: 3 film announcements, 2 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: The Inbetweeners Reunion Movie
film.announcement: Netflix is developing a reunion movie with the original lead cast set to return.

film.title: VJ Frames Launch Title
film.talent: Tiger Shroff, Abhishek Banerjee, Elvish Yadav; Directed by Remo D'Souza
film.announcement: Tiger Shroff to star in VJ Frames' launch title directed by Remo D'Souza, with Abhishek Banerjee and Elvish Yadav also cast.

film.title: Barbie Sequel
film.talent: Margot Robbie, Ryan Gosling, Greta Gerwig
film.announcement: The Barbie sequel has stalled as Warner Bros. attempts to reach deals with director Greta Gerwig, Margot Robbie, and Ryan Gosling over salary negotiations.

tv.title: Lioness
tv.announcement: Taylor Sheridan is returning for an on-camera role in Lioness Season 3.

tv.title: New Girl Revival
tv.announcement: Max Greenfield revealed he has seen scripts for a New Girl revival and stated 'As far as I know, it's happening.'
